blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty.
We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar.
Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model–dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor.
The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Despite their overwhelming popularity, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are still prone to hallucinations : they generate fluent, confident answers that are not grounded in their input Ji et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024a) . Knowing when an output should not be relied upon has therefore become essential, which is the role of uncertainty quantification (UQ) Hernandez-Lobato and Adams (2015) ; Gal and Ghahramani (2016) .
blocks.zh: 尽管大语言模型(LLMs)和大视觉语言模型(LVLMs)受到压倒性的欢迎,但它们仍然容易产生幻觉:它们产生流利的,自信的答案,这些答案并没有扎根于它们的输入Ji等人(2023年);刘等人(2024年a). 因此,知道何时不应依赖某项产出变得至关重要,这就是不确定性量化(UQ)赫尔南德斯-洛巴托和亚当斯(2015年);加尔和加赫拉马尼(2016年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The Operator Bottleneck in Semantic UQ. Semantic uncertainty methods decompose into a pairwise comparison operator ( s s ) and a structural aggregator ( F F ). While prior work focuses on designing sophisticated aggregators, they inherit off-the-shelf operators that suffer from misaligned training objectives or severe scaling bottlenecks. We identify the operator as the true bottleneck and introduce a contrastively trained, question-conditioned bi-encoder. Serving as a universal drop-in replacement, our learned operator universally improves the performance of existing aggregators at a fraction of the computational cost of NLI baselines.

blocks.en:
Early token-level methods operate directly on autoregressive token probabilities Malinin and Gales (2021) ; Aichberger et al. (2024) .
However, these measures conflate lexical variation with semantic variation. Given the question “What is the capital of France?” , a model may output “The capital of France is Paris.” (A1), “The capital of France is Madrid.” (A2), or “It’s Paris.” (A3) (Fig. 1 , top row).
A1 and A3 agree on the fact, yet receive different token-level scores because they differ in wording and structure.
A model that is entirely certain of the correct fact can thus appear highly uncertain simply due to lexical diversity.

Semantic UQ methods resolve this by evaluating generations in a space of meaning rather than vocabulary Farquhar et al. (2024) .
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , they share a common template: sample N N answers, compare them pairwise, and aggregate the resulting comparison structure into a scalar uncertainty score.
We formalize this template as U = F ⁡ ( 𝑺 ) U=F({\bm{S}}) , where an operator s s scores pairwise semantic equivalence to form an N × N N\times N matrix 𝑺 {\bm{S}} , and an aggregator F F summarizes its structure.

(2024) , computing von Neumann entropy over graph Laplacians (KLE) Nikitin et al. (2024) , or analyzing the spectrum of a similarity matrix (COS) Chen et al. (2024) .
In every case, the operator s s is treated as a secondary design choice. Prior work reports that switching between off-the-shelf operators yields limited improvements Farquhar et al. (2024) , which we argue occurs not because the choice is unimportant, but because none of these operators is structurally suited for the task.

blocks.en:
This reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ.
As illustrated in the “Prior Work” row of Fig. 1 , when existing operators evaluate generated text, they suffer from severe distribution shifts and misaligned objectives.
External sentence encoders evaluate general topical overlap, blinding them to targeted factual contradictions (e.g., scoring “The capital is Paris” and “The capital is Madrid” as highly similar).
Internal hidden states are optimized for autoregressive next-token prediction, which induces a strong recency bias that prioritizes shared syntactic suffixes over factual denotation.
Finally, Natural Language Inference (NLI) cross-encoders
successfully incorporate the question but frame the comparison as strict directional entailment.
This fundamental misalignment causes them to artificially fracture meaning clusters when identical facts are expressed with natural, asymmetric verbosity.
Furthermore, evaluating entailment requires joint pairwise inference, imposing an O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) computational bottleneck.
No existing choice evaluates targeted factual equivalence conditioned on the question, aligns natively with the generative distribution of the LLM, and scales efficiently.

blocks.en:
In this work, we show that the operator, rather than the aggregator, is the true bottleneck of semantic UQ because off-the-shelf metrics fail to measure factual equivalence (Fig. 1 , bottom row). Instead of designing a new aggregator, we treat the equivalence operator as a first-class object of study.
To bypass the flaws of human-annotated NLP datasets, we extract a native metric space from the language model itself. When an LLM samples multiple responses, it might produce both correct and incorrect answers.
This predictive variability provides a source of weak supervision: correct answers collapse into a single semantic equivalence class, while incorrect answers diverge.

为了绕过人类附加说明的NLP数据集的缺陷,我们从语言模型本身中提取一个本土的度量空间. 当LLM对多个响应进行取样时,可能会产生正确和不正确的答案.

blocks.en: By utilizing this structural property, we introduce a question-conditioned bi-encoder trained via a contrastive triplet objective. Trained offline without any semantic annotations, on a dataset disjoint from all evaluation settings, our encoder learns to look through lexical overlap and isolate factual divergences. During inference, it produces a mathematically symmetric similarity matrix 𝑺 {\bm{S}} using only O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) forward passes, serving as a universal, drop-in replacement for any existing aggregator.

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) We formalize semantic UQ as the composition of a comparison operator and an aggregator ( U = F ⁡ ( 𝑺 ) U=F({\bm{S}}) ), isolating the off-the-shelf operator as the primary bottleneck limiting current methods. (2) We introduce a framework to extract a native semantic geometry using weak supervision from the LLM’s own predictive variability, training a question-conditioned equivalence bi-encoder without manual semantic labels. (3) We demonstrate that our operator acts as a universal upgrade: replacing the default operators in SE, CAE, KLE, and COS improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model–dataset combinations with both LLMs and LVLMs, raising the mean AUROC from 0.68 to 0.76 while bypassing the O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) scaling bottleneck of entailment baselines. (4) We show that the benefits extend beyond semantic aggregation: the geometric norm of our bi-encoder assigns an intrinsic importance score to individual tokens, yielding a lightweight reweighting mechanism that strictly improves single-generation token-level methods.

blocks.zh: 3 语义 UQ 中的操作员 Bottleneck

blocks.en: Semantic UQ methods estimate uncertainty by measuring agreement across multiple model generations rather than relying on token-level probabilities. While the literature presents a diverse array of estimators, we observe that they all share a common structural decomposition.

The Entailment Trap (NLI Cross-Encoders). NLI models are trained for directional entailment, not for deciding whether

This shows that NLI can confuse differences in form with differences in
meaning, motivating an operator trained directly on LLM generations.

blocks.en: Crucially, this pipeline requires absolutely no semantic equivalence annotations or UQ confidence labels. While the training dataloader leverages binary correctness labels to construct triplets, the geometric objective forces E 𝝍 E_{{\bm{\psi}}} to learn a generalized function of equivalence , not absolute truth. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We formalized semantic uncertainty quantification as the composition of an operator that decides whether two generations answer a question the same way, and an aggregator that turns the resulting comparisons into a scalar. We observed that every method in this family proposes the latter while inheriting the former from a model built for another task. We introduced a framework for training such an operator on the relation it is meant to express, utilizing a contrastive objective and synthetic data disjoint from every evaluation setting. Substituted into SE, CAE, KLE, and COS, it improves them across 18 model–dataset combinations, requiring only N N network evaluations instead of O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) . The uniformity of this improvement substantiates our core hypothesis: a single change to the shared component improves every baseline estimator built on it.
blocks.zh: 我们把语义上的不确定性量化正式化为一个操作者的组成,它决定两代人是否以同样的方式回答一个问题,以及一个汇总器,它将由此产生的比较变成一个平面。 我们注意到,这个家庭中的每一种方法都提出后者,同时从为另一项任务而建立的模式中继承前者。 我们采用了一个框架,培训这样一个操作人员了解它所要表达的关系,利用一个与每个评价环境脱节的对比性目标和综合数据。 它被替换为SE, CAE, KLE, 和COS, 它通过18个模型-数据集组合来改进它们,只需要N N网络评价而不是O Q(N 2) O(N^{2}). 这一改进的统一性证实了我们的核心假设:对共同组成部分的一次改变可以改善每一个基于该部分的基线估计值。

blocks.en: The operator is trained on a small synthetic set with a single configuration, and might benefit from more data and a finer-grained objective. We left it there deliberately: the claim we set out to test is that the operator is the limiting component, not that ours is the best one, and our aim was not to introduce a new supervised uncertainty method. That a recipe this minimal already improves every estimator is the point, and it leaves considerable room above the estimates reported here.

Token Entropy. TE is the simplest uncertainty estimate, it operates directly on the predictive distributions produced during decoding, and requires a single generation. At step t t , the model defines a distribution over the vocabulary 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , whose Shannon entropy H t ( 𝒙 , 𝒚 < t , 𝜽 ) = − ∑ v ∈ 𝒱 p ( v ∣ 𝒙 , 𝒚 < t , 𝜽 ) log p ( v ∣ 𝒙 , 𝒚 < t , 𝜽 ) H_{t}({\bm{x}},{\bm{y}}_{<t},{\bm{\theta}})=-\sum_{v\in\mathcal{V}}p(v\mid{\bm{x}},{\bm{y}}_{<t},{\bm{\theta}})\log p(v\mid{\bm{x}},{\bm{y}}_{<t},{\bm{\theta}}) (A.2) measures how dispersed the model is over the possible continuations at that position. The token-level uncertainty of a generation is obtained by averaging these entropies over the generated sequence: U TE ​ ( 𝒚 ∣ 𝒙 , 𝜽 ) = 1 T ​ ∑ t = 1 T H t ​ ( 𝒙 , 𝒚 < t , 𝜽 ) . U_{\mathrm{TE}}({\bm{y}}\mid{\bm{x}},{\bm{\theta}})=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}H_{t}({\bm{x}},{\bm{y}}_{<t},{\bm{\theta}}). Every position contributes equally to the average, although the positions differ widely in how much they bear on the answer: a model may hesitate between several equally acceptable phrasings while being certain of the answer itself, and such hesitation raises U TE U_{\mathrm{TE}} exactly as hesitation over the answer would.
Semantic methods compare generations by meaning rather than by token sequence.

blocks.en: B.1 Clustering of Incorrect Answers
blocks.zh: B.1 对不正确答复的分组

blocks.en: As described in Section 4.3 , we use answer correctness as a proxy for semantic equivalence when building training triplets. Two answers to the same question form a positive pair if both are correct, and a negative pair if one is correct and the other is not. Pairs of two incorrect answers therefore never appear as positives during training. This raises a natural concern: the encoder might only learn to group correct answers together, and fail to group incorrect answers that share the same meaning.
blocks.zh: 如第4.3节所述,我们在建造三胞胎训练时将回答正确性作为语义等同性的代名词。 同一问题的两个答案如果两者都正确,则形成正对;如果一个正确,则形成负对. 因此,在培训期间,两个错误答案的对等从未显示为正面。 这引起了一个自然的担忧:编码器可能只学会将正确的答案组合在一起,而没有将具有相同含义的不正确的答案组合在一起.

blocks.en: We argue that this concern does not hold, because correctness enters the pipeline only through the construction of triplets. The encoder never receives a correctness label as input and is never trained to predict one. The objective in Eq. 7 depends only on inner products between answer embeddings, so what the encoder learns is a notion of equivalence between answers, not of truth . For a given question, all correct answers share the same denotation, which makes correctness a convenient and reliable source of equivalent pairs. The notion of equivalence the encoder learns from these pairs is not tied to the correct answer, and it transfers to answers that agree on the same incorrect content.
blocks.zh: 我们辩称,这种关切并不存在,因为正确性只有通过建造三胞胎才能进入管道。 编码器从未收到正确性标签作为输入,也从未受过预测一个的训练. Eq. 7中的目标只取决于答案嵌入之间的内在产物,所以编码器学到的是一个答案之间等同的概念,而不是真理的概念. 对于一个特定的问题,所有正确的答案都有着相同的解说,这使得正确性成为了对等的方便和可靠的来源. 编码器从这些对子中学习到的等效概念与正确的答案没有绑定,它转移到同意同样不正确的内容的答案.

blocks.en: Tab. B.1 illustrates this behavior with two pairs of paraphrases answering the same question: one pair is correct and the other is incorrect. The encoder assigns nearly identical similarities to both pairs ( 0.975 0.975 and 0.980 0.980 ). It therefore groups paraphrases based on their shared meaning, regardless of whether that meaning is correct. This is precisely the behavior required by downstream semantic UQ aggregators: when a model consistently produces the same hallucination, the corresponding samples should fall into a single cluster, yielding low semantic entropy that reflects the model’s (misplaced) confidence.

blocks.en: Appendix D LLM as a Judge
blocks.zh: 附录D LLM作为法官

blocks.en: We rely on an LLM-as-a-judge procedure at several stages of our pipeline. This section clarifies exactly how and where it is used.
blocks.zh: 我们依赖一个LLM-as-a-judge程序 在我们的管道的几个阶段。 本节确切澄清了使用方式和地点。

blocks.en: Given a question, an answer generated by the model under study, and the ground-truth answer, we prompt a larger external LLM to decide whether the generated answer matches the ground truth. The judge is never asked whether the generated answer is correct in its own opinion. Its role is restricted to comparing the generated answer with the reference, which accounts for paraphrases, formatting differences, or partial verbosity that exact-match or token-overlap metrics would miss. This text-to-text comparison is a simple task for a large instruction-tuned model. We use this procedure to annotate the training set.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个问题,一个由正在研究的模型生成的答案,以及地面真相答案,我们促使一个更大的外部LLM来决定生成的答案是否与地面真相相符. 法官从未被问及生成的答案在自己看来是否正确. 其作用仅限于将生成的答案与参考物进行比较,该参考物记述了句法,格式化差异,或部分动词,准确匹配或符号重叠的度量符会错过. 这种文本对文本的比较对于一个大指令调制模型来说是一个简单的任务. 我们用这个程序来说明训练集

blocks.en: Evaluating uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods requires a single binary label per question, and two strategies are common in the literature. In the first, a greedy answer is generated alongside the sampled answers used to compute the uncertainty measures, and this greedy answer is labelled with the judging protocol above. In the second, each of the N = 20 N=20 sampled answers is labelled individually, and the question receives the majority label among them. Both strategies are reasonable. We adopt the greedy-answer strategy for our main results because it is the more direct of the two.
blocks.zh: 评估不确定性量化(UQ)方法要求每个问题有一个单一的二进制标签,文献中常见两种策略. 首先,一个贪婪的答案与用来计算不确定性计量的抽样答案一起产生,这个贪婪的答案与上面判断的协议贴上了标签. 在第二个中,N = 20 N = 20 个抽样答案中,每个被单独标注,问题得到其中多数标注. 这两种战略都是合理的。 我们对主要结果采取贪婪的回答策略,因为它是两者中最直接的。

blocks.en: To rule out any dependency between the labels used for training and those used for evaluation, we use a different judge for each split: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct annotates the training set, and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct annotates the test set. We have no specific reason to expect such a dependency, but using distinct judges removes it by construction.
blocks.zh: 为了排除用于培训的标签与用于评估的标签之间的任何依赖性,我们用不同的法官来判断每一分法: Quen2.5-32B-指示注释训练集,Llama-31-70B-指示注释试验集. 我们没有具体理由期望这种依赖性,但使用不同的法官通过建筑消除这种依赖性。

blocks.en: The performance of our method does not depend on the aggregation strategy. The main results table reports scores computed with greedy-answer labels, and App. G.3 compares results under both strategies, showing that the conclusions are consistent.

Hidden-state representations are read at the final answer token, so they are shaped most
by what the sequence ends on. To test whether this displaces the fact that determines
correctness, we construct pairs that end identically and disagree earlier. The pipeline,
applied to the NQ-OPEN train split, is:

隐藏状态的表示在最后的回答符号中被读取,所以它们被塑造得最多
以序列的结局为准。 要测试这是否取代了决定
正确,我们构建的对 结尾相同,不同意更早。 管道,
适用于NQ-OPEN列车拆分,是:

per-sample correctness labels, and split them into a correct and an incorrect subset. 2. Match on suffix. Search for a correct/incorrect pair sharing their last

disagreeing on the fact stated earlier in the sentence. 3. Extract. Teacher-force each answer as the continuation of the question in
a single forward pass with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct , and take the final-layer hidden state at the last answer token.

blocks.en: F.3 The entailment trap (NLI cross-encoders)
blocks.zh: F.3 联合国 内置陷阱( NLI 交叉编码器)

blocks.en:
Entailment is a directional relation, and two answers can convey the same fact while
differing in how much else they say. To test whether this fractures valid semantic
clusters, we construct pairs that are equivalent by construction but maximally apart in
verbosity. The pipeline, applied to the NQ-OPEN train split, is:
blocks.zh:
贴近是一种方向关系,两个答案可以传达同样的事实,同时
他们所说的不同 测试此断裂是否有效的语义
组群,我们构建的对对 等于构造,但最大程度的分开在
动词. 适用于NQ-OPEN列车拆分的管道为:

blocks.en:
1. Sample and label. For each query, take the 20 20 sampled answers and their
per-sample correctness labels. 2. Keep the correct ones. Discard every answer not labelled correct, so that
each remaining answer is independently verified as conveying the reference fact. 3. Pair the extremes. Pair the shortest correct answer with the longest,
giving one pair per query spanning the range of natural response verbosity.
blocks.zh:
一、导 言 样本和标签。 对于每个查询,取20个抽样答案及其
每样本正确性标签。 2. 保留正确的。 丢弃每个没有标记的答案,这样
每一个剩余答案都经过独立核查,以传递参考事实。 3. 对等极端。 用最短的正确答案和最长的答案

trained on human-annotated corpora expect well-formed sentences, while QA references are
often bare entities. To quantify this, we compare each generated sentence against the
reference string it matches. The pipeline, applied to the NQ-OPEN train split, is:
